title: Viridian, awaiting FDA decision, taps WuXi Bio in eye drug supply deal
llm_note: Viridian has signed a manufacturing supply agreement with CDMO WuXi Biologics for its eye drug.

title: WuXi’s Facility in China Receives Brazilian GMP Certification for Dengue Vaccine Manufacturing
llm_note: WuXi Vaccines' Suzhou facility received ANVISA GMP certification for dengue vaccine manufacturing.

title: WuXi Bio signs deal to manufacture Viridian's thyroid eye disease drug
llm_note: WuXi Biologics has signed an explicit contract to manufacture Viridian’s thyroid eye disease drug.

title: Intravacc Secures French CIR Approval to Support Vaccine R&D Partnerships
llm_note: Intravacc received French approval to provide cGMP manufacturing services to vaccine R&D partners.

title: GLP-1 manufacturer CordenPharma strikes deal for peptide CDMO, lining up new production sites in US and China
llm_note: CordenPharma is expanding peptide manufacturing capacity with new production sites in the US and China.

title: Work underway on vaccines, antivirals against rare Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak
llm_note: Serum Institute of India is explicitly named as the manufacturer standing ready to produce the Ebola vaccine.
